info.title: Dialektik Public Read API
info.description: Anonymous Event-first product reads. Internal scores, interpretations, moderation records, and provider diagnostics are absent by contract.

429.description: The per-client public read limit was exceeded.

get.summary: List current Events in fixed chronological order.
get.description: The only order is detected_at descending with Event ID as a stable tie-breaker. Category and topic are discovery filters, never epistemic rankings.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque keyset cursor bound to this route and its filters.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Defaults to 20 and cannot exceed 50.

200.description: A deterministic page of Event cards.

400.description: Invalid request, identifier, filter, limit, or cursor.

429.description: The per-client public read limit was exceeded.

500.description: The request failed without exposing internal diagnostics.

get.summary: List published Positions for an analyzed Event.
get.description: One self-sufficient list response ordered only by immutable neutral_rank. ANALYSIS_PENDING returns an explicit unavailable-analysis error, never a fabricated or provisional Position.
